title: complex-map-2d widget params
description: A self-contained 'drag the probe through a complex map' engine. The author supplies a complex function via `function f(x,y){ return [u,v]; }` (z = x+iy maps to w = u+iv). The engine draws the image of the coordinate grid under f (the warped conformal grid) and a draggable probe point z; as the reader drags z, the image w = f(z) and a small image-of-a-cross at z update live, with the readout reporting z, w, the local stretch |f'(z)| and rotation arg f'(z) (central finite difference), and whether angles are preserved (conformal where f' != 0). The gesture is 'drag-probe' — direct manipulation of a point through a holomorphic map, a dimension the corpus otherwise lacks. jsdom-safe: createSVGPoint/getScreenCTM run only inside the pointer handlers, never at init.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. The Reset button derives its id from it (widgetId+'-reset').

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> drawing surface.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout the engine writes z / w / |f'| into.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should tell the reader to drag the probe point.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

range.description: Half-width of the data window: both axes span [-range, range]. Default 2.5.

gridExtent.description: Coordinate grid lines drawn from -gridExtent to +gridExtent at unit spacing. Default 3.

initialZ.description: Initial probe point [x, y] in data coords. Reset restores it. Default [1, 0.6].

bodyScript.description: Author JS defining `function f(x,y){ return [u, v]; }` — the complex map z = x+iy ↦ w = u+iv (data coordinates). The engine calls it to draw the image grid, the probe image, and the local frame. Must not start a timer.
